memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Insomnia and asymptomatic gout.
Patient reports trouble falling asleep, waking after 4-5 hours, daytime fatigue, and mild joint discomfort without swelling or redness. Exam: vitals normal, lungs clear, no tophi, joints non‑tender. She denies snoring or apnea. Smoking: former, stopped 2020, 10 pack‑years. No current inhaler use. Insomnia Severity Index score 18 (borderline). TSH 2.1 µIU/mL (ref 0.4‑4.0). Hb 12.8 g/dL (ref 12‑16). Serum uric acid 6.8 mg/dL (ref <7.0). Creatinine 0.9 mg/dL (ref 0.5‑1.1).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Melatonin 3 mg HS
Trazodone 50 mg HS
Allopurinol 100 mg OD

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Insomnia improved, gout asymptomatic.
Patient reports sleep onset within 30 minutes, waking once per night, feeling rested. No joint pain. Exam: vitals stable, lungs clear, no joint swelling or tenderness. Smoking status unchanged. Insomnia Severity Index score 12 (well controlled). TSH 2.0 µIU/mL. Hb 13.0 g/dL. Serum uric acid 5.9 mg/dL. Creatinine 0.9 mg/dL.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been having trouble sleeping again – taking >45 min to fall asleep and waking up at 3 am. I feel tired during my driving shifts. My joints feel fine.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Insomnia worsening, gout asymptomatic.
Patient reports increased sleep latency (>45 min), early morning awakening, daytime fatigue affecting work. No joint pain or swelling. Exam: vitals normal, lungs clear, no tophi, joints non‑tender. Smoking: former, stopped 2020, 10 pack‑years. Insomnia Severity Index score 20 (borderline well controlled). TSH 2.2 µIU/mL. Hb 12.9 g/dL. Serum uric acid 6.2 mg/dL. Creatinine 0.9 mg/dL.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Acute gout flare, insomnia stable.
Patient reports sudden severe pain and swelling in left first metatarsophalangeal joint, began 2 days ago, worsened with walking. No fever. Exam: left MTP joint swollen, erythematous, tender, limited range of motion. Insomnia: reports sleep latency 30 min, no awakening, feels rested. Smoking: former, stopped 2020, 10 pack‑years. Insomnia Severity Index score 13 (well controlled). TSH 2.1 µIU/mL. Hb 13.0 g/dL. Serum uric acid 7.6 mg/dL (elevated). Creatinine 0.9 mg/dL.
